name: VLR-Bench-zh
description: VLR-Bench-zh is a Chinese visual-language reasoning benchmark that measures a model's ability to answer visually grounded questions in Chinese using image-question pairs. It focuses on visual grounding and inference (e.g., object attributes, relations, and scene understanding) rather than free-form caption generation. The dataset contains both multiple-choice and open-ended items to probe different aspects of image-based reasoning.
reputation: A specialized, relatively new benchmark with modest adoption in Chinese V&L research and growing interest.
